lines.text: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah, signed first, followed by the priests, the Levites, and the leaders of the people.
The rest of the people and their families swore an oath to follow the Law of God given through Joshua.
They promised not to give their daughters in marriage to the people of the land or take their daughters for their sons.
They promised not to buy goods from the people of the land on the Sabbath, and to cancel every debt every tenth year.
They promised a third of a shekel yearly, wood, firstfruits, firstborn animals and tithes, so they would not neglect the house of their God.
